summary: Royalty Pharma plc filed an 8-K to disclose entry into a $1.8 billion unsecured revolving credit facility, refinancing and replacing its prior 2021 credit agreement. The borrower is Royalty Pharma plc, with Royalty Pharma Holdings Ltd and Royalty Pharma Manager, LLC as guarantors and Bank of America as administrative agent. Interest options include base rate or SOFR-based rates plus applicable margin, with a commitment fee on unused amounts. Financial covenants require a consolidated leverage ratio at or below 4.00x (4.50x post-material acquisition), a portfolio cash flow ratio at or below 5.00x, and a coverage ratio at or above 2.50x. This is a routine refinancing of a credit facility, not a special situation.
